purpose: Recommendation-safety regression: negation, conditions, actor ownership, inputs versus outputs.

apps.name: PrivacyMeter
apps.readme: PrivacyMeter aggregates smart meter readings for neighbourhood energy reports. It does not collect personal data.

apps.name: HomeTrack
apps.readme: HomeTrack collects personal data and appliance usage from households to build energy profiles.

apps.name: ForecastHub
apps.readme: ForecastHub forecasts day-ahead electricity prices from market data.

apps.name: PlanGrid
apps.readme: PlanGrid schedules home battery charging against day-ahead price forecasts supplied by the user.

apps.name: LiveBid
apps.readme: LiveBid submits flexibility bids to the energy market operator.

apps.name: SimBid
apps.readme: SimBid submits flexibility bids to the market only in simulation.

apps.name: FailSense
apps.readme: FailSense predicts equipment failures from vibration measurements.

apps.name: PartnerLink
apps.readme: PartnerLink sends equipment data to an external analytics service. Another application predicts the failures.

apps.name: FieldCrew
apps.readme: Field engineers inspect substations and record faults in FieldCrew. FieldCrew stores the fault reports.

apps.name: OfflineBox
apps.readme: OfflineBox logs meter data locally and works without internet access.

apps.name: CloudLog
apps.readme: CloudLog logs meter data in the cloud. An internet connection is required.

apps.name: SettleSoon
apps.readme: SettleSoon records flexibility activations. Automatic settlement is planned for a future release.
